TOA 4 (Tropical Architecture) lines 649-670: Site planning should orient openings to prevailing winds, use operable windows and ceiling vents, and add shaded verandas, balconies, and landscaping.

TOA 4 (Tropical Architecture) lines 1562-1573: Green building in tropical climates reduces cooling load by filtered air movement, shade, and vegetation that does not block circulation.
